data.action: 并肩共读留三厘米距离，侧脸微近，余光偷看
data.camera: medium two-shot, window seat reading, dust motes, quiet intimacy
data.description: 辉夜与你并肩坐在靠窗的阅读位，两本书之间刻意留出三厘米的距离——这是她计算过的、既不会越界也不会疏远的安全值。翻页的间隙她的侧脸靠近了一点，红瞳的余光一直落在你的书页上。午后的光尘在两人之间浮游，谁都没有开口，谁都没有挪开。
data.lighting: 窗边洒落的明亮午后光与浮游光尘
data.location: 秀知院图书室靠窗阅读位
data.promptProse: Kaguya and her companion sit side by side at the window reading seat, their two open books separated by a three-centimeter gap. She glances at her companion's page without moving her own book; window light catches dust and paper edges.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 图书室的共读午后·「距离……刚好是三厘米」
data.animaCaption: Their two open books remain three centimeters apart as she glances at her companion's page.
